lcc_original: 土地必給你長出荆棘和蒺藜來；你也必喫田間的菜蔬；
notes: UNV 地 → LCC 土地 (both = ground/earth); neither has an explicit SN tag on the subject noun itself in UNV, so none added in LCC
Prefix marker <WAH09001> placed before 長出 in LCC mirroring its pre-verb position in UNV, with <WH06779><WTH8686> following after 長出
LCC uses 喫 (archaic form) vs UNV 吃 for 'eat'; <WH0398><WTH8804> attaches to 喫 normally
LCC 荆棘 vs UNV 荊棘 — variant character forms for the same word (thorns); <WH06975> attaches straightforwardly
{<WAH0853>} kept as implicit braces since LCC also has no explicit direct-object marker word
LCC terminal punctuation ；preserved (not changed to 。as in UNV)
